definitions: A city in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, located near the borders with Belgium and the Netherlands.
Historically known as Aix-la-Chapelle, it was a favored residence of Charlemagne and a significant center of the Carolingian Empire.
examples: Charlemagne made Aachen a center of his empire.
The Treaty of Aachen was signed in 1748.
Aachen is known for its thermal baths.
